variants.melee: The roads need hands who can hold their ground. Read the marked assignment, take your weapon, and work with your party. Your own part in the fight is what earns this contract.
variants.magic: A useful spell is one you can rely on when someone needs it. Follow this assignment with real casts, keep enough ether to finish, and use the marked worksite when the instructions call for it.
variants.ranging: A bow can protect a road without drawing every threat onto the workers. Take this assignment to its marked site and make your own shots count.
variants.summoning: A summoned ally is a partner, not a substitute for judgement. Follow this assignment with your own creature and keep the party together at the worksite.
variants.harvesting: We need fresh gathering to keep the wagons moving. Walk to the marked patch and choose Start. What you gather after starting this assignment counts; old stock can stay in your pack.
variants.alchemy: Take this assignment to The True Note and choose Start before mixing fresh batches. You keep the goods. If you later choose to donate ordinary stock, I can add the posted bonus; enriched supplies are yours to keep.
variants.hold_worksite: The repair crew cannot abandon its camp every time raiders appear. Hold that ground through three attacks, watch the changing approaches, and meet the threats with your own weapon.
variants.sweep_camps: Three hostile posts are choking the road. Clear those positions with your party so the repair crew can secure the approaches. Your own melee contribution still matters.
variants.healing_line: The recovery camp has wounded people who need more than a guard. Protect them and restore health they have actually lost. Casting on someone already healthy will not fill this order.
variants.break_siege: Hostile posts have closed the wardens' escape route. Use your magic to break those positions and keep the crew safe as the way opens.
variants.ridge_sentinels: The lookout must hold while the roads below are checked. Defend its crew through three attacks, using your own bow and keeping enough ammunition for each approach.
variants.trail_pursuit: Ambushers are scattered along the route ahead. Find and clear their posts with your own ranged attacks so the crew can pass safely.
variants.supply_guard: Our supplies are gathered in one place, and the raiders know it. Hold the camp through three attacks with your own summoned ally helping defend it.
variants.hunt_burrows: Hostile posts are spreading ahead of the patrol. Take your own summoned companion and clear those positions before they close the route again.
variants.harvest_bundle: A useful supply needs balance. This order lists two different resources and a fresh quantity of each. Start at the marked patch, then gather both parts of the basket.
variants.harvest_survey: We need a dependable supply, not one lucky patch. Start at the marked site, gather the fresh quota, and work three distinct resource nodes for the survey.
variants.alchemy_reagents: Follow this order from gathering to preparation. Start at its marked site, gather the listed fresh ingredient, then mix successful batches of the posted essence family.
variants.alchemy_stock: This order needs goods for the shelves. Start the assignment, mix its fresh batches, and bring the listed ordinary essences when you report. Enriched results count as mixing practice and stay yours.
